Where your records are

On your iPhone and Apple Watch. With iCloud Sync on, also in your private iCloud database. Isocline Labs stores none of it.

Moving to a new iPhone

Turn on iCloud Sync in Settings, under Privacy & Data, then sign in to the same Apple ID on the new phone. You can also export everything as CSV or JSON.

What the curve is

The curve is modeled from the doses you log and calibrated to your lab results when you add them. It is an estimate, not a measurement.

Keeping it discreet

Reminders name no medication by default. The app icon can be switched to a plain one, and App Lock puts Face ID in front of your records.

Isocline Plus

Subscriptions are billed by Apple. To change or cancel one, open Settings on your iPhone, tap your name, then Subscriptions.

Medical note

Isocline is a record and a model. It does not diagnose, recommend doses or replace your clinician.
